lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.groverFindAll_correctness
lean.annotation: The challenge fixes the decoder in `decodeTargets n k (σ res) = S`. A candidate may choose its circuit and workspace, but the final output must encode all of $S$ under that decoder.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.groverFindAny_rel_cost
lean.plain: Find-Any round bound for large domains
lean.annotation: The challenge fixes the cost predicate and the Find-Any reference scale. A candidate may submit a smaller value of `groverFindAnyRelCost` if its proof establishes the tighter bound for all sufficiently large $n$.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.groverFindAll_rel_cost
lean.plain: Find-All round bound for large domains
lean.annotation: The cost and correctness statements use the same Find-All program, supplied with the oracle for each $S$. Cost takes a uniform mean of the expected rounds at each marked set. Random relabeling can turn that mean into a bound uniform over marked sets for a symmetrized program.
